title: Can You Stop and Go Ashore on a Private Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: On Chifbay's trips you stay on the water: the Day Trip swims from the boat at Fajã dos Padres and Ribeira Brava. For a landing, ask on WhatsApp before booking.
heroAlt: Guest on a boat stern with feet in the sea, an empty pebble beach under cliffs ahead
keywords: can you go ashore on a private boat trip in Madeira
does the boat stop at Fajã dos Padres
